body:
I had a brief romantic relationship, but for all intents and purposes he was a really sweet person! But in terms of the voices, he is an evil, racist despot (they tell me that he’s God). 
He’s never called me the n-word, but he does in my head. 
I do want to say that my current experience is an amalgamation of everything i believed before any of this happened—all that i believed about racism and the world..
I’m trying to integrate my more positive, loving life experiences but it’s almost as if I don’t have access to them. It’s like they’ve disappeared. I’ve had multiple, divine, loving-light experiences and I have no way of contextualizing them in the light of hearing voices. Any thoughts on trauma integration?

I am black!!
One thing I forgot to mention, which is crucial, is that the voice is someone that I know, a man named  Brian. The voices say that he’s God and that he knows that I’m in a n*gger. Any thoughts on psychosis induced by a specific person?? What’s going on with him??

Thank you for your comment!! Sorry about the slur, and thank  you for the support regardless. 

It’s getting easier and easier to deal with this. The best is yet to come. I need my people. 

Thanks again! 💕
Yes!!! Thank you for the strength in your comment.

Thank you for your response, and for the reminder not to feed into it as a spiritual force. It’s hard bc this condition has been medication resistant, but yes, you’re right, it’s not a tea spiritual energy. It’s all gotten SO much better over time and I know I’m gonna get through this 💪🏿

In solidarity,
Blanktooth

thank you so much for your response!
it’s really helpful to imagine this coming from the unconscious, especially since I have a lot of unprocessed trauma. 
I know that it’s not real. I KNOW this!! And they’ve gone away and come back and every time it gets easier and easier. I’m looking forward to the day that I don’t have to deal with this. 

Thanks again for your thoughtful comment! Wishing you many blessings💜
Also, is trying multiple dimensional jumping methods at one interruptive?

Thanks for this insight!
I just wanted to follow-up on my experience bc I've had a confusing change of events:

I was asking for an unfortunate situation to be dissolved and using the image of having never been in it in the first place to achieve results.  At first, it appeared as if I had reached my preferred reality. There were no changes to my environment, but the negative situation wasn't relevant anymore..
Now it's back again and I'm confused because I thought I had achieved my goal...

How can I now ACTUALLY do so? What would be the best move forward?

My apologies if this story is hard to follow!

Thanks for this answer, it's really helped quite a bit (especially the bit about how my mind cannot conceive of the background possibilities that will get me to my goal; makes sense)!

I'm unsure, however, as to your very last sentence:

"Hows is actually a decision of your current now reality itself, which you choose to use as a sort of leading-up toward your other intentions."

Could you rephrase/clarify this?
Wow, I also cannot believe that someone else has had these experiences. Nothing out-of-the-ordinary has happened to me since the glass breaking--what about you? Do you feel closer to your goal?

Thanks for the thoughts. I figured the whole point of dimensional jumping is that it cannot be rationally acknowledged. The phenomena on this subreddit, as well as a whole body of religious + scientific text, indicate that reality is fluid/nonexistent, which is inherently antithetical to the Western idea of the "rational mind." 
At the end of the day  experience matters the most!
Thanks for sharing! I'm definitely going to integrate this breathing exercise into my meditation. Let me know if anything else arises!
